text.description_html:
Fusion TR-E5, St. Charles Fleur-De-Lis Hand Towel Ring

The St. Charles Hand Towel Ring is mounted to the wall usually near the bathroom sink. It is great for keeping small towels off the ground and out of the sink not only in the bathroom, but also in the kitchen as well. The fleur-de-lis designs along the edge really grant this bathroom accessory a traditional feel. Choose from either medium bronze or oil rubbed bronze finishes.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TB-E5 St. Charles Towel Bar, Fusion PH-E5 St. Charles Toilet Paper Holder, and Fusion RH-E5 St. Charles Robe Hook

Features and Specifications of the Saint Charles Series Towel Ring:

  • Mount Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
